ui.captured_officer.recruit_accepted_sum.zhHant: 武將「{0}」接受招降，願於「{1}」效力。
ui.captured_officer.recruit_accepted_sum.en: Officer "{0}" accepted recruitment and will now serve in "{1}".

ui.captured_officer.free_speech.zhHant: 今日得免於難，此情我記下了。來日是敵是友，且看天命。
ui.captured_officer.free_speech.en: I will remember this mercy. Whether we meet as foe or friend again, let fate decide.

ui.captured_officer.kill_speech.zhHant: 成王敗寇，事已至此，我無話可說。只願後人記得我曾盡忠。
ui.captured_officer.kill_speech.en: The victor writes the end. I have little left to say, save that I served with all my loyalty.

ui.captured_officer.recruit_accept_speec.zhHant: 承蒙不棄。自今日起，我願盡心效力，還望明公信任。
ui.captured_officer.recruit_accept_speec.en: You have shown me mercy. From this day on, I will serve with all I have.

ui.captured_officer.recruit_accept_speec.zhHant: 明公厚待於我，我自當知恩圖報，不負今日之選。
ui.captured_officer.recruit_accept_speec.en: Your generosity will not be forgotten. I will repay this trust with loyal service.

ui.captured_officer.recruit_accept_speec.zhHant: 既賜重禮，又肯容我立足。我願收下此情，效命麾下。
ui.captured_officer.recruit_accept_speec.en: You grant both honor and a place to stand. I accept, and will serve under your banner.

ui.captured_officer.recruit_accept_speec.zhHant: 既蒙委以職位，我自當謹守本分，以功績回報知遇。
ui.captured_officer.recruit_accept_speec.en: Since you entrust me with office, I will answer that faith with worthy deeds.
